info.title: WizLeads API Reference
info.description:
# Introduction ## Authentication Use `x-api-key` header to pass the API key. API key can be generated inside the [WizLeads Dashboard](https://app.wizleads.io/api). ## Rate Limits Rate limit for the API is 10 calls per second across all endpoints. Any calls above this limit will return a 429 error. Excessive calls may lead to a 1 hour ban on both the user and the IP.

If using API inside Clay, set Request Limit to 10 and Duration (in ms) to 1000. ## Credit Consumption - Task Management - Profile/Company Search Result Scraping - 1 credit per result - Account-Less Mode - 2 credits per result - Email Enrichment - Find Work Email - 3 credits per email found - Find Personal Email - 5 credits per email found - Verify Email - 0.5 credits per email - Phone Enrichment - Find Mobile Number - 100 credits per number found - Profile Enrichment - Enrich Profile - 4 credits per profile enriched - Company Enrichment - Enrich Company - 3 credits per company enriched - Get LinkedIn ID of Company - 1 credits per company Find Work Email, Find Personal Email, and Find Mobile Number only charge when a result is found. Verify Email charges for every email processed, regardless of the result.

Enrich Profile and Enrich Company only charge for inputs that return data. Profiles that cannot be fetched, companies unknown to LinkedIn, and inputs rejected as invalid are never charged. Converting a company username to a company ID inside Enrich Company is free.

Find Work Email, Find Personal Email, and Find Mobile Number serve repeat lookups of the same input within 72 hours from cache and do not charge again. Enrich Profile and Enrich Company are never served from cache. ## Batch Inputs Find Personal Email, Enrich Profile, and Enrich Company accept up to 25 inputs per call. Pass them either as repeated query parameters (`?urns=A&urns=B`) or as a single comma separated value (`?urns=A,B`). These endpoints always return a JSON array.

Results are not guaranteed to be in the same order as the inputs. Match them back on the identifier each entry carries - `urn` for Find Personal Email and Enrich Profile, `id` for Enrich Company.

A single call counts as one request against the rate limit, regardless of how many inputs it carries.

default.name: x-api-key
default.description: You can generate an API key from the dashboard.

inputs.description: Input parameters for the task. All parameters are not given for all task types. Task List contains less information than Task Detail.

accounts.description: List of account IDs to use. Set to null for automatic selection. Only available when useAccountless is false.

links.description: List of Sales Navigator search URLs to scrape.

id.description: Numeric ID assigned to each link, unique to this task.

count.description: Number of results present on this link.

count_scrapeable.description: Number of results that can be scraped.

split_complete.description: Has splitting of link (if enabled) completed.

splits.description: Invocation IDs given to all sub-links for this link. Progress is tracked by invocation ID. There is only one invocation per link if splitting is disabled or count is below threshold.

useAccountless.description: Whether to use Account-Less scraping mode.

enrichEmails.description: Whether to enrich emails. Only available for task type "salesnav-profile".

splitSearches.description: Whether to split links larger than threshold into smaller sub-links.

column_mapping.description: JSON string for mapping required fields to your CSV column names.

account.description: Account type used for this task.

credit_base.description: Credits charged per scraped result. Does not include credits charged for enrichment.

link.description: Download link for CSV results. Final results are available only when task is in a terminal state - Done, Aborted, or Failed.

link_size.description: Total number of unique results present in CSV.

dones.description: Number of results already scraped for each invocation ID.

ongoing.description: Number of results being scraped for each invocation ID.

totals.description: Number of total results for each invocation ID.

enrich_final.description: Total number of enriched results present in CSV.

enrich_size.description: Number of emails found for each invocation ID.

enrich_msg.description: Enrichment status for each invocation ID - STARTED, SUCCESS, RESTARTING, SYSTEM_ERROR, INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS, TASK_ABORTED.

enriched.description: Number of rows processed for each invocation ID.

CompanyData.description: Company data as held by LinkedIn. Fields that LinkedIn does not publish for a company are returned as null.

specialties.description: Specialties listed on the company page.

revenue.description: Exact revenue, when LinkedIn publishes one.

revenue_range_lower.description: Lower bound of the estimated revenue range.

revenue_range_upper.description: Upper bound of the estimated revenue range.

accounts.description: List of account IDs to use. Set to null for automatic selection. Only available when useAccountless is false.

links.description: List of Sales Navigator search URLs to scrape.

useAccountless.description: Whether to use Account-Less scraping mode.

enrichEmails.description: Whether to enrich emails. Only available for task type "salesnav-profile".

account.description: Account type to use for this task.

post.description: Only tasks with status "Queued" or "In Progress" can be aborted. Status immediately changes to "Aborting" and then "Aborted" after few seconds. Results scraped till time of abort are available to download.

get.description: View all your tasks with status and live progress.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Maximum allowed value is 25.

get.description: Check status and live progress of a running task, and download the results in CSV format.
Find a professional email address given a person's name and company website. All emails are valid and catch-all verified. Credits are only charged when an email is found.

Find personal email addresses given LinkedIn profiles. All emails are valid and verified. Accepts up to 25 profiles per call and returns an array. Credits are only charged for the profiles where an email is found.

parameters.name: li_url
parameters.description:
Sales Navigator URN of the profile, in the format `ACwAA...`. The public username (e.g. `williamhgates`) is not accepted and is returned as `INVALID_INPUT` without charge.

Repeat the parameter or pass a comma separated list to look up several profiles at once, up to a maximum of 25.

LinkedIn URNs of the format `ACoAA...` are also accepted, but limited to 1 URN per request.

urn.title: URN
urn.description: The Sales Navigator or LinkedIn URN extracted from the input.

email.title: Email
email.description: Personal email address. Returns null if no email could be found.

status.title: Status
status.description: Verification status of the email. Null when no email was found.

error.title: Error
error.description:
Null when the profile was looked up successfully, whether or not an email was found.
`INVALID_INPUT` means the input was not a valid LinkedIn URN and was never looked up.
`UNAVAILABLE` means the lookup could not be completed and should be retried.
Neither case is charged.

503.description: Enrichment temporarily unavailable. No credits are charged - retry the call.

get.description: Verify whether an email address is valid and deliverable. Also performs catch-all validation. Credits are charged for every email processed, regardless of the result.

post.description: Find professional emails in bulk by uploading a CSV file. All emails are valid and catch-all verified. Credits are only charged for emails that are found.

column_mapping.description: JSON string for mapping required fields to your CSV column names. Required fields: `firstName` and `company_website`. Optional: `lastName`. If `lastName` is omitted, pass the full name in `firstName`.

file.description: CSV file containing the leads to enrich.

post.description: Verify email addresses in bulk by uploading a CSV file. Also performs catch-all validation. Credits are charged for every email processed, regardless of the result.

column_mapping.description: JSON string for mapping the `email` field to your CSV column name.

file.description: CSV file containing the emails to verify.

get.description: Find a person's mobile phone number given their LinkedIn profile. Credits are only charged when a phone number is found.

parameters.name: li_url
parameters.description: LinkedIn profile URL. Bare slugs (`williamhgates`) and member URNs (`ACoAA...` or `ACwAA...`) are both accepted.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Mobile phone number in E.164 format. Returns null if no phone number could be found.

get.description:
Enrich LinkedIn profiles into full profile data - positions with company details, education,
skills, certifications, and contact information. Accepts up to 25 profiles per call and
returns an array. Credits are only charged for the profiles that are successfully enriched.

parameters.name: urns
parameters.description:
Sales Navigator URN of the profile, in the format `ACwAA...`. The public username (e.g. `williamhgates`) is not accepted and is returned as `INVALID_INPUT` without charge.

Repeat the parameter or pass a comma separated list to look up several profiles at once, up to a maximum of 25.

LinkedIn URNs of the format `ACoAA...` are also accepted, but limited to 1 URN per request.

error.title: Error
error.description: Only present for inputs that were rejected before lookup. `INVALID_INPUT` means the input was not a valid LinkedIn URN. Never charged.

id.title: Member ID
id.description: Numeric LinkedIn member ID. Null when the profile could not be fetched, in which case the remaining fields are also null and no credits are charged.

is_open.description: Whether the member has an Open Profile.

is_premium.description: Whether the member has a Premium subscription.

emailPersonal.title: Personal Email
emailPersonal.description: Personal email on the profile, when the member has published one. Not verified - use Verify Email or Find Personal Email if verification is needed.

phoneNumbers.description: Comma separated phone numbers published on the profile.

positions.description: Full position history, most recent first.

fieldOfStudy.description: Comma separated when more than one field is listed.

503.description: Enrichment temporarily unavailable. No credits are charged - retry the call.

get.description:
Enrich LinkedIn companies into full company data. Accepts company IDs, usernames and page URLs,
up to 25 per call, and returns an array. Converting a username or URL to a company ID is done
automatically and is not charged. Credits are only charged for the companies that LinkedIn returns data for.

parameters.name: companies
parameters.description:
Company ID, username, or LinkedIn page URL.

Repeat the parameter or pass a comma separated list to enrich several companies at once, up to a maximum of 25.

id.title: Company ID
id.description: Null when the username or URL could not be resolved to a company ID, in which case no credits are charged and no company data is returned.

employee_growth_%_SIX_MONTHS.description: Percentage change in employee count over the last six months. Growth fields are only present when LinkedIn reports a non-zero value.

employee_growth_%_YEAR.description: Percentage change in employee count over the last year.

employee_growth_%_TWO_YEAR.description: Percentage change in employee count over the last two years.

503.description: Enrichment temporarily unavailable. No credits are charged - retry the call.

get.description: Convert the Linkedin page URL or username of a company to the corresponding company ID.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company page URL or username on LinkedIn.

id.title: Company ID
id.description: Returns null if no ID could be found. No credits are charged.

company.title: Company Username
company.description: Returns the updated username if company username has changed.
